name: Uli Latukefu
bio: Uli Latukefu is an Australian actor and singer best known for his role as Dwayne Johnson in the NBC comedy series Young Rock, where he portrays a young version of Johnson during his college football years. Born in Australia to Tongan parents, Latukefu began his career in the Australian entertainment industry, gaining recognition through roles in Marco Polo and Alien: Covenant.
